description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogDao class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It provides data access methods for handling PerformanceTrackerLog entities, such as fetching logs by ID, tracker ID, user ID, and performing bulk updates or deletions. The class utilizes Doctrine ORM query builders to interact with the database and supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for PerformanceTrackerLog entities, providing methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and filtering performance tracker logs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Fetches a PerformanceTrackerLog by ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerLogIdsForTrackerId
methods.description: Returns IDs of tracker logs that exist and match given IDs and tracker ID.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of PerformanceTrackerLog entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a Doctrine QueryBuilder with filtering for tracker ID and non-deleted status, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Counts the number of logs for a given performance tracker and achievement rating.

methods.name: savePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Persists a PerformanceTrackerLog entity to the database.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Marks tracker logs as deleted based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogIdsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves tracker log IDs associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsIdList
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all tracker logs where associated employee is not purged.
